messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: high runtime p99 latency on runtime-prod (threshold 1200ms, observed 2.3s) — alert id PD-88421. Auto-resolve configured after 60s of normal.

maya: saw this, getting paged. looking at graphs now.

ben: acked via PD (ack by ben). pinging carla for infra context.

pagerduty-bot: ben acknowledged alert PD-88421. Escalation timer paused.

carla: i'm on, i just pulled up traces — lots of short-lived spikes from kv-cache misses in shard-7, start ~13:42:10 UTC. overall qps steady.

maya: can we confirm if any rollout or infra job started around that time?

carla: nothing in deploy log. but I see many warmup requests clustering — looks like a small thundering herd after auto-eviction on that node.

ben: could be retired KV nodes? checking controller events...

ben: controller shows evict/recover churn on node gpu-7 for 40s starting 13:41:58. probable cache eviction -> cold K/V reload -> p99 up.

maya: impact? any customer errors or increased 5xx?

carla: no user-facing 5xx spike in last 5m, only latency. downstream retries minimal. customers should be fine, but SLAs care about p99.

maya: cool. try a quick mitigation: pin heavy models away from gpu-7, and temporarily increase cache TTL for shard-7. carla can you push?

carla: pushing TTL bump to 10m for shard-7 now.

carla: ran config change:
```
# config snippet
kv_cache:
  shard: shard-7
  ttl_seconds: 600
  prefetch: true
```

carla: TTL update applied, controller accepted.

incident-bot: Alert PD-88421 auto-resolved at 13:43:02 UTC (duration 35s) — signal dropped below threshold.

maya: nice, looks like it cooled. still seeing a couple small blips in the traces but stable.

ben: leaving a note: this was noisy because the alert threshold is too tight for short eviction events. PD config currently triggers on single-sample 2m window.

maya: agree — we should avoid paging on transient KV warmups. set suppress rule: require sustained 3 datapoints over 2 minutes. also consider grouping by shard so we don't page for single-shard blips.

carla: created a draft alert change:
```
- name: runtime-p99-high
  expr: p99(runtime_latency) > 1200
  for: 2m
  group_by: [shard]
```

carla: will push to staging for 30m then prod if green.

ben: FYI i escalated to oncall-next (snooze window) so they see the handoff notes.

oncall-next: thanks — i'll watch dashboards for the next hour. if it reappears and doesn't auto-resolve we'll run a deeper RCA.

maya: short RCA notes for timeline (for postmortem if it repeats):
- 13:41:58 controller evicted cache on gpu-7 (runtime job churn)
- 13:42:10 p99 spikes to ~2.3s due to cache misses
- 13:42:30 carla bumped TTL and enabled prefetch for shard-7
- 13:43:02 PD alert auto-resolved (35s)

maya: customer impact: none observed (no 5xx, retries within client timeouts). internal SLA p99 breached briefly; recommend alert tuning + small controller backoff to avoid eviction churn.

carla: opened a follow-up task in infra backlog to add jitter/backoff to eviction loops and add a metric on eviction count per node.

ben: adding post-incident note to the oncall doc and linking this thread. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks everyone. closing thread if no more noise. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: PD-88421 closed (auto-resolved)."
